correctness.rationale: For invertible real unit-row A, maximizing lambda_min(A^T diag(p) A) is exactly minimizing T=sum w_i subject to diag(w)-C PSD with C=(AA^T)^-1 and p_i=w_i/T. On separating diagonal entries, minimization of sum q_i is dual to elliptope maximization 2sum c_ij X_ij. Balanced sign product yields weighted graph Laplacian primal with rank-one sign-vector dual; frustrated strict triangle uses a rank-one primal vv^T and rank-two correlation Gram of unit vectors whose weighted sum vanishes; frustrated weak reciprocal edge uses a signed Laplacian with PSD Schur complement. Matching certificates prove global optimality; dual complementary nullspaces fix all q_i and guarantee uniqueness, including equality boundary. Inverse Gram gives positive weights; explicit G(t) substitution yields kink at t=2/5 and minimum eigenspace dimension 1 before, 2 after. Independently checked five rational G(t) values using exact PSD principal minors/eigenvalues and branch weights. Finite SDP experiments are only corroboration.
